text: This report recommends amending the Construction Agreement for PO0100379 - Tiger Boardwalk and Habitat Project in order to complete additional work.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Authorized the Director, Facilities and Infrastructure, Toronto Zoo, or their designate, to negotiate and amend the Construction Agreement for PO0100379 - Tiger Boardwalk and Habitat Project up to the amount of $4,800,000.00, excluding applicable taxes.
